model_output.verdict: An experienced elementary teacher whose classroom results and grade-level leadership are easy to see.
write_up: Your resume makes a strong case for elementary teaching: it connects your work in Title I schools with classroom growth, grade-level leadership and family programs. A recruiter can see both who you teach and what you've taken on beyond your classroom.

The reading growth line is especially strong! It names the district assessment, gives the starting and ending measures, and shows the period over which growth happened. Your K-8 certification and English Language Learner endorsement are easy to find below your experience.

I'd keep the classroom results and team leadership front and center, then add what you contributed to the behavior support committee. Your resume is unlikely to be what holds you back; the school's needs and how competitive the opening is will matter too.

cards.line: - Raised the class's average reading growth on the district assessment from 0.8 to 1.4 grade levels per year over three years
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It gives a recruiter a concrete measure to hold onto without making them guess which assessment you mean.
